name: List Jira Sprints
description: Lists sprints for an agile board (id, name, state). Use to find a sprint id, or to see active/future sprints. Requires a board id (see the List Jira Boards skill).
author: anything-jira

input.hint: Base URL of your Jira Server / Data Center instance.
Jira Data Center Personal Access Token. Sent as a Bearer token. Stored locally in this skill's plugin.json.

state.description: Optional comma-separated sprint states to filter: 'active', 'future', 'closed'.
